title: Why Expensive Eggs Are a Lie
summary: Short video on egg-carton labels arguing cage-free, free-range, organic and pasture-raised say little about hen welfare and that third-party welfare certifications are the better signal.

verdicts.note: Organic rules require hens to be uncaged with year-round outdoor access and organic feed, and a 2023 rule set outdoor space minimums.

7 CFR 205.238 applies to all organic livestock, poultry included: it requires housing that limits disease and conditions allowing exercise, freedom of movement and lower stress, and it bans de-beaking, beak trimming after 10 days and induced molting (the avian living-conditions section 205.241 is not in this excerpt).
